scope: Independent prime-norm adapter algebra;exact char101 coefficients/degree drops and conditional unit recovery. Curves/Picard/projective completion/jet bridge and old balanced reducer remain written/native;local Lean is unsigned.
statement: theorem unit_ordinate_recovery {K : Type} [CommRing K] (f m inverse n q X Y a b : K) (unit : m*inverse=1) (cover : f*m^2=n^3+a*n*q^4+b*q^6) (fibre : n=X*q^2) (target : Y^2=X^3+a*X+b) : (Y*q^3*inverse)^2=f
